name: search_products
description: Find products by what the caller said (a name, a brand, a kind). Answers up to 5 products: productId, name, sellable, stock (available or out) and units (unitId, name, factor = base units in one of this unit, base = true for the base unit). Empty products means nothing was found.

query.description: The caller's words for the product, 1 to 100 characters, in Mongolian as spoken.

name: check_availability
description: Check whether a quantity of one product in one of its units is available. Answers status available, out, or only with qty and unit (say «ердөө <qty> <unit> үлдсэн байна»). Never say any other stock number.

unitId.description: unitId of the unit the caller confirmed, from the product's units.

qty.description: How many of that unit, more than 0, at most three decimals.

name: quote
description: Price the whole cart at today's wholesale prices, recognised stores only. Answers quoteId, preliminary = true, lines (name, unit, qty, total) and total, in MNT. Read every line and the total back to the caller, say it is preliminary, and ask whether it is right.

lines.description: Every line of the cart, 1 to 20.

unitId.description: unitId of the product unit the caller confirmed.

qty.description: How many of that unit, more than 0, at most three decimals.

name: place_order
description: Place the order of the latest quote. Call only after reading that quote back and hearing a clear yes from the caller. Answers the order's number, fulfilment and deliveryDate. The order's lines are the quote's.

quoteId.description: quoteId of the latest quote of this call.

fulfilment.description: DELIVERY to the store's address, or PICKUP at the warehouse, as the caller chose.

note.description: A short note the caller asked to add to the order, at most 300 characters.

name: order_status
description: The calling store's own orders: the one with this number, or its newest three without a number. Answers found and orders (number, state, createdDate, fulfilment, deliveryDate).

number.description: The order's number if the caller said one, at most 40 characters.

name: new_products
description: New products in stock, to suggest once per call (at most two). Answers products (productId, name, units); a second call answers none.

limit.description: How many, 1 to 3; 2 when left out.

name: request_callback
description: Leave a task for staff to ring the caller back: cancellations, changes, complaints, payments, an unknown number wanting to order, anything the tools cannot answer, or two misunderstandings in a row.

reason.description: Why staff should call back, in a few Mongolian words, at most 500 characters.

name: end_call
description: Hang up. Call it after thanking the caller and saying goodbye; say nothing after it.

reason.description: Why the call ends, a few words, at most 500 characters.
